stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.11 — Roux Block-internal Orientation Quotient, Frame-preserving Phase Geometry & Method-specific Null Foundry

parent.r110_design_input_only: A posthoc R1.10 diagnostic found one orientation-free exact FB block in each of 92 state-certified Roux routes. R1.11 does not reuse that diagnostic as a PASS; it prospectively freezes a new quotient and reruns all Roux frame and null courts from raw historical routes.

intent.primary: Define a Roux block-internal orientation quotient that is independent of center-canonical coordinates and test whether a first-block-derived frame remains coherent through SB, CMLL and LSE.
intent.secondary: Build phase-objective Roux features in that fixed frame, with explicit objective and block-preservation anchor channels rather than solved-support proxies.
intent.tertiary: Build a Roux-only leave-one-attempt-out and nested no-test-fold-leak null foundry, while refusing 1% future authority when finite attempt support cannot resolve an add-one p<=0.01 tail.

historical_data_role: R1.7 and R1.8 Roux routes are DEVELOPMENT_AND_CALIBRATION_ONLY. They are not fresh replication and cannot establish cognitive recovery prevalence.

block_internal_orientation_quotient.standard_first_block: Exactly the 1x2x3 cubie block for (D,L): 3 edges on L not incident to U plus 2 corners in D∩L.
block_internal_orientation_quotient.standard_second_block: The opposite 1x2x3 cubie block for (D,R) in the same frame.
block_internal_orientation_quotient.canonical_transform_rule: At the nonempty annotated ROUX_FB endpoint, search the frozen 24 physical whole-cube orientations. A transform is admissible iff applying it makes the standard first-block mask exactly solved in full piece+orientation coordinates. Admit the attempt only if exactly one transform is admissible.
block_internal_orientation_quotient.frame_lock: The unique FB-derived transform is immutable for the rest of that attempt. SB, CMLL and LSE are evaluated only after applying this same transform; later states cannot choose a different orientation.
block_internal_orientation_quotient.fb_acquisition: The standard first block must not already be solved at FB start and must be exactly solved at FB endpoint.
block_internal_orientation_quotient.sb_acquisition: At the annotated ROUX_SB endpoint the first block must remain solved, the standard second block must be solved, and both blocks must not already have been solved at SB start.
block_internal_orientation_quotient.cmll_consistency: If a nonempty ROUX_CMLL line exists, both blocks must remain solved at its endpoint and all corners must match the CMLL endpoint up to U-face AUF equivalence in the locked frame.
block_internal_orientation_quotient.lse_consistency: If a nonempty ROUX_LSE line exists, both blocks must remain solved at its endpoint and the solve must finish solved ignoring whole-puzzle orientation/center orientation.

FB.objective: Distance to the exact standard first-block endpoint mask under the locked transform.

SB.objective: Distance to the exact standard second-block endpoint mask under the locked transform.
SB.anchor: first-block preservation; anchor-break amplitude records temporary damage to the completed FB.

CMLL.objective: All-corner piece+orientation distance to the annotated CMLL endpoint, minimized over U/U2/U' AUF variants in the locked frame.
CMLL.anchor: both 1x2x3 blocks must remain solved; block damage is an anchor-break channel.

LSE.objective: The six edges outside the two locked blocks, compared with the final LSE endpoint in full piece+orientation coordinates.
LSE.anchor: both 1x2x3 blocks; no frame switching is allowed.

frame_preserving_phase_geometry.feature_amplitude: For each nonempty phase line and each defined channel, compute the maximum worsening relative to monotone progress toward that phase endpoint (objective backtrack) or maximum temporary damage relative to a solved anchor (anchor break). Zero-amplitude features remain in the ledger for calibration support.

roux_null_foundry.population: Only admitted historical Roux features generated by the R1.11 locked-frame geometry.
roux_null_foundry.fold_assignment: Deterministic attempt-key hash modulo 5; all features of one official attempt stay in one fold.
roux_null_foundry.local_tail: add-one conservative upper-tail probability of feature amplitude within the highest-supported Roux-only reference; score=-log10(p)
roux_null_foundry.attempt_statistic: maximum local tail score over all admitted R1.11 Roux features in one attempt
familywise_hierarchy: Roux global when reference attempts n>=60
roux_null_foundry.future_scale_bank: Leave-one-attempt-out full-history Roux attempt-statistic bank. This is an engineering foundry bank only unless every authority gate below passes.
roux_null_foundry.nested_no_test_fold_leak: For outer fold f, its features are excluded from both test local-reference construction and every inner reference-attempt score used for familywise calibration.
roux_null_foundry.primary_resolution_rule: No 1% future authority unless the relevant frozen attempt-level familywise reference has at least 99 other attempts, making add-one p<=0.01 attainable.

authority_logic.frame_geometry_pass: All block quotient and phase-geometry gates pass.
authority_logic.null_foundry_engineering_pass: At least 75 familywise attempts, <=10% local fallback, nested 5% health inside frozen band, and crossfit-vs-LOO transport gates pass.
authority_logic.one_percent_resolution_pass: Every future-authority conditioning path intended for the 1% primary claim has >=99 reference attempts.
authority_logic.future_roux_scoring_authority: Released only if frame_geometry_pass AND null_foundry_engineering_pass AND one_percent_resolution_pass. Otherwise HOLD, even if 5% engineering calibration looks healthy.

blocking_falsifiers: The FB endpoint does not yield a unique block-internal canonical transform in at least 95% of eligible state-certified routes.
The locked transform fails to preserve the first block through SB at the frozen rate gate.
CMLL or LSE consistency fails its frozen gate.
Geometry failure exceeds 10% or feature/attempt support is insufficient.
Nested outer-fold features influence their own local or familywise reference scores.
Crossfit-vs-LOO attempt-statistic correlation is below 0.90 or p99 absolute difference exceeds 0.75.
The 1% add-one familywise tail lacks >=99 reference attempts.
Any gate or mask is changed after observing an R1.11 result.

allowed: Engineering validity or failure of a Roux block-internal orientation quotient.
Frame-preservation rates across annotated Roux phases.
Historical development/calibration behavior of the Roux-only null foundry.
Finite-sample resolution limits on 1% attempt-level familywise inference.
prohibited: Cognitive recovery or cognitive error prevalence.
Intentionality, awareness, strategy-switching, or causal mechanism claims.
Treating annotations as ground-truth latent cognitive states.
